entries.title: Strand of the Ancients
body: The titans left their mark on Northrend mostly in the ground, as at Ulduar. But on a narrow chain of islands off the Dragonblight's southern coast, a sliver of their work stands in the open. As the Horde and Alliance spread across Northrend, their mystics woke to dizzying visions of an isle and a gleaming power behind walls of stone: a titan relic, said to hold vital knowledge of the titans and their ways.
The citadel's towers and great gates still loom, but its walls are crumbling and rusted. They can be brought down.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg: Strand of the Ancients (Official overview, Description)

entries.title: The Gates of the Citadel
body: Three walls stand between the beach and the relic, their gates named for jewels and for the sun and moon.

entries.title: The Courtyard of the Ancients
body: The citadel's heart, where the titan relic is kept.
